## Why This Is Asked

- Distinguishing syntax vs semantic validation
- HTTP 400 vs 422 error handling
- Fuzz testing for robustness; schema evolution
- Non-PII handling and safe error messages

```yaml
schema:
  $schema: http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#
  type: object
  required:
    - tenant_id
    - user_id
    - model_version
    - client_revision
    - timestamp
    - features
  properties:
    tenant_id:
      type: string
      maxLength: 128
    user_id:
      type: string
      maxLength: 128
    model_version:
      type: string
      pattern: "^v\\d+\\.\\d+"
    client_revision:
      type: string
      maxLength: 64
    timestamp:
      type: string
      format: date-time
    features:
      type: object
      properties:
        feature1:
          type: number
        feature2:
          type: number
      required:
        - feature1
        - feature2
    device_id:
      type: string
      maxLength: 128
  additionalProperties: false
```
